scientific_integrity: Every infinite-parameter conclusion is supported by explicit analytic arguments, not a numerical truncation. The verification script exercises finite identities only. No authorship, independent priority certification, or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classical Fourier gamma coefficients are prior art. The stated new claims concern sharp endpoint norm geometry, integer cusp laws, and strong-convergence topology on the infinite nearest-neighbor lattice. Earlier equivalent Wiener-algebra norm identities cannot be excluded without independent historical comparison.
title: Exact endpoint norms and integer-order cusps of the lattice fractional Laplacian
